plugin_description: Connects Elaina to a NapCat OneBot v11 WebSocket.
connection_hint: The adapter reconnects automatically; a configuration change restarts the connection.
configured: Configured; enter a new value to replace it
settings_hint: Values are stored per plugin. Empty fields fall back to the environment defaults, and saving a connection change restarts the channel immediately.
config_ws_url_hint: NapCat forward WebSocket address, for example ws://127.0.0.1:3001. Falls back to ELAINA_ONEBOT_WS_URL when empty.
config_access_token_hint: Token NapCat requires for this connection. Falls back to ELAINA_ONEBOT_ACCESS_TOKEN when empty.
config_mode_hint: Forward: Elaina dials NapCat. Reverse: NapCat dials Elaina. Defaults to forward.
config_host_hint: Interface the reverse WebSocket server binds to. Reverse mode only; defaults to 127.0.0.1.
config_port_hint: Port the reverse WebSocket server listens on. Reverse mode only; defaults to 3002.
config_channel_id_hint: Identifier for this channel instance. Incoming events and chat objects are stored under it; defaults to onebot.
config_bot_account_hint: The bot's own account id, used to recognise its own messages. Defaults to elaina-server.
config_reply_as_quote_hint: Quote the message being answered instead of sending a standalone reply.
config_split_max_chars_hint: Maximum characters per reply chunk; longer replies are split. Defaults to 2000.
config_send_interval_hint: Delay in milliseconds between consecutive reply chunks. Defaults to 400.
config_pending_grace_hint: Grace period in milliseconds before an unconfirmed delivery is reconciled. Defaults to 15000.
config_ptt_hint: Turn voice messages into text when a transcriber is available. Enable it, or switch it off to ignore voice content.
config_ptt_timeout_hint: How long one transcription may take.
config_forward_expand_hint: Download and expand forwarded message bundles before the model sees them. Enable it, or switch it off to keep only the summary node.
config_forward_max_chars_hint: Character budget for one expanded bundle.
config_forward_max_nodes_hint: Maximum number of nested messages to expand.
config_forward_timeout_hint: How long fetching one forwarded bundle may take.
config_group_manage_hint: Allow administrators to run group actions: mute, kick, rename, card, title, and whole-group mute.
config_self_manage_hint: Allow administrators to change the bot account itself: avatar, profile, long nickname, online status.
config_delete_group_file_hint: Allow administrators to delete files from NapCat group storage.
config_raw_allowlist_hint: Raw OneBot action names the agent may call through rawAction. Empty disables raw calls entirely.
config_admin_users_hint: OneBot user ids allowed to run destructive actions such as group management and raw calls.
config_admin_titles_hint: Group member titles that count as administrators. Reserved for the legacy configuration; the runtime does not read it yet.
config_reconnect_hint: Exponential backoff used while NapCat is unreachable.
config_reconnect_max_hint: Upper bound for the retry delay. Defaults to 30000.
config_reconnect_jitter_hint: Random spread applied to each delay, between 0 and 1. Defaults to 0.1.
config_action_timeout_hint: How long one NapCat API call may take before it fails. Defaults to 5000.
